resolved_conflicts.explanation: Montana has two lookouts called Sunset Peak. The Missoula County site (1944, gone 1955, 47.31803 -113.70171) is the subject here; the Mineral County tower (1934, destroyed 1959, 8 miles SW of St. Regis) is a separate site and is not used for this record's facts.

notes_for_editor: Only two pages describe this site. The firelookout.com detail page gives the 1944 date, the 20' L-4 tower, the 1955 'Gone' year, the forests and the location; the firelookout.org state list confirms it as gone with coordinates. Neither says why or how the tower left, what remains, whether the ground is public, or who staffed it, so those are left out. No NHLR or FFLOS record for this site turned up in the pages read. The Archives West Lolo NF map series (https://archiveswest.orbiscascade.org/ark:80444/xv96920) lists '716 Sunset Lookout, 1934-1936'; it is not tied to either site and its dates do not match 1944, so it is not used. No photos found. The brief's record (name, county, coordinates, status gone) matches the sources; no corrections proposed.
